SELECT distinct B.USER_NAME AS id, B.REAL_NAME AS text
,D.INSTITUTION_CODE institutionCode
FROM SYS_ROLE C LEFT JOIN SYS_USER_ROLE A ON C.ROLE_ID = A.ROLE_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_USER B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_NAME
LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_CODE = B.DEPT_CODE
C.ROLE_POS = #{rolePos,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and (B.USER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) or (B.REAL_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))))
and B.USER_NAME = #{initValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT distinct B.REAL_NAME FROM SYS_USER B
B.USER_NAME = #{userName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT SEQ_NO seqNo, ROLE_POS rolePos, USER_NAME userName, ASSET_TYPE assetType, ASSET_SEC_TYPE assetSecType, TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, TRADE_DIRECTION tradeDirection, AUTHORIZE_TYPE authorizeType, case when AUTHORIZE_TYPE = #{AUTHORIZE_TYPE_02,jdbcType=VARCHAR} then AUTHORIZE_LIMIT_AMT/10000 else null end AUTHORIZE_LIMIT_AMT FROM RSK_AUTHORIZE_MNG
SEQ_NO = #{seqNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT SEQ_NO seqNo, ROLE_POS rolePos, USER_NAME userName, ASSET_TYPE assetType, ASSET_SEC_TYPE assetSecType, TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, TRADE_DIRECTION tradeDirection, AUTHORIZE_TYPE authorizeType, AUTHORIZE_LIMIT_AMT authorizeLimitAmt FROM RSK_AUTHORIZE_MNG where USER_NAME = #{userName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /** update by 张年 20190904 同一个用户授权类型不可重复*/

select distinct T1.USER_NAME id, T2.REAL_NAME text from RSK_AUTHORIZE_MNG T1 left join SYS_USER T2 on T1.USER_NAME = T2.USER_NAME
and (T2.USER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) or (T2.REAL_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))))

SELECT ASSET_TYPE assetType, ASSET_SEC_TYPE assetSecType, TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, TRADE_DIRECTION tradeDirection, AUTHORIZE_TYPE authorizeType, AUTHORIZE_LIMIT_AMT/10000 authorizeLimitAmt FROM RSK_AUTHORIZE_MNG
USER_NAME = #{userName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
